scope: Offline diagnosis before the matched L2 study; no optimizer steps or environment/evaluation cells

sample.selection: First 2048 of the previously sampled 4096 historical-valid replay starts

steering_and_exploration.nominal_actuator_equivalence: Official front-wheel joint limits are +/-0.4; motor command saturates at angular error0.06. Within nominal joint limits, targets above+0.46 or below-0.46 request equivalent respective saturated motor commands.
steering_and_exploration.target_clip_observation: At abs(mean)>=0.99, even the maximal opposite clipped target perturbation leaves abs(action)>=0.49, above the nominal0.46 threshold.
steering_and_exploration.interpretation: Logit saturation, squash-gradient recovery, and physically distinct steering exploration are different properties. Wheel inertia, gas/brake noise, changed observations and saturated-command duration still affect trajectories. No exploration intervention is authorized by this observation alone.

reward_and_replay.interpretation: Raw tile credit and step cost have no explicit finish bonus. This is the frozen objective, not incorrect terminal handling. Negative finish-step reward does not prove lower total finish return; preceding states can receive bootstrapped credit. Negative rewards do not necessarily mean physically off-road.

q_and_gradient_scale.interpretation: Reconstructed final-checkpoint CPU gradients, not historical gradient logs. Values and losses are finite. Adam normalization prevents equating the clip multiplier to an equivalent parameter-step reduction; there is no measured systematic Q1 optimism justifying a bundled critic change.

temporal_information.interpretation: History is present and used. Out-of-distribution frame permutations do not establish adequate velocity estimation or justify a temporal rearchitecture. Saturated output can conceal latent sensitivity.

augmentation.interpretation: Material lack of translation invariance persists outside negative terminal tails. Padding/cropping may also remove information or shift HUD elements; offline sensitivity is not evidence of improved driving under a smaller augmentation.

conditional_second_axis.status: not selected, implemented or launched; decide only after matched L2 results
conditional_second_axis.necessary_evidence: L2 restores its intended gradient mechanism but fails replicated completion improvement; standardized same-state post-study probes still show material shift instability.
conditional_second_axis.control: If L2 is rejected, coefficient0 in BOTH augmentation arms; no combined repair, no pad sweep, no reward/noise/frame-skip/architecture changes.
conditional_second_axis.acceptance: Fresh repeated completion improvement against a matched control, never reduced shift sensitivity alone
conditional_second_axis.stop: At most this one additional evidence-backed single-axis trial; stop instead if justification is insufficient. No third trial or new algorithm.
